Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear your company team,

You close by heading back to the machines—it sounds like a practical discussion without unnecessary back-and-forth would suit you best. We want competitive pricing and delivery commitments that work in production. What flexibility on payment or delivery timing would help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Joanna Kaczmarek
